question:
A Kustomize base for the `weighbridge` app is in `/home/candidate/exam/q3/base`: a Deployment `weighbridge` (3 replicas, `nginx:1.25`) and a Service `weighbridge` selecting `app: weighbridge`, both in namespace `tally`. Do not modify the base.

1. Create a canary overlay at `/home/candidate/exam/q3/overlays/canary/kustomization.yaml` that uses `../../base` as its resource and renders **exactly one object**: a Deployment named `weighbridge-canary` (name suffix `-canary`) with `1` replica and image `nginx:1.26`, whose pods carry the extra label `track: canary` while keeping `app: weighbridge`, so the existing Service also routes to them. The overlay must not render a Service.
2. Apply the base and the canary overlay with `kubectl apply -k`.

When done, the Service `weighbridge` (selector unchanged) must have 4 ready endpoints: 3 stable pods and 1 canary pod.

verification.description: Deployment weighbridge has 3 ready replicas of nginx:1.25
Deployment weighbridge-canary has 1 ready nginx:1.26 replica labelled app=weighbridge, track=canary
Service weighbridge (selector app=weighbridge) has 4 endpoints including 1 canary pod
overlays/canary uses ../../base and renders only Deployment weighbridge-canary; base unchanged
